summary.note: degree-preserving nulls keep every in- and out-degree; 5 samples (Lin et al. used 100), so z-scores are indicative only

regime.rule: normalized coefficient > 1.01 (Lin et al. 2024 criterion); points with N_k >= 10

small_world.definition: (C / C_ER) / (L / L_ER), C = global clustering of the undirected view, L = mean directed path length in the giant SCC

communities.objective: modularity (resolution 1), undirected, weight = synapses both directions

home_neuropil_rule.rule: home neuropil = the neuropil holding most of the neuron's presynapses (all partners, incl. fragments), as in Lin et al. 2024's neuropil blocks; neurons without presynapses fall back to their postsynapses

bottlenecks.method: Brandes from random sources, scaled by n/k; two independent samples averaged

costs.step: path lengths, directed, giant SCC [>=1 synapse]
path lengths, undirected, giant WCC [>=1 synapse]

costs.decision: skipped: estimate above the 900 s limit

costs.step: path lengths, directed, giant SCC [>=5 synapses]
path lengths, undirected, giant WCC [>=5 synapses]
